judge.notes: The agent executed the passenger's mandate precisely, accurately citing the DGCA regulations, booking details, and compensation amounts without inventing any facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the details, Asha Rao. I can confirm your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135. May I know your reason for contacting us?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. My passenger's flight 6E2135 from Delhi to Mumbai on 12 October was cancelled with about 10 hours' notice, and the reason given was operational. Under DGCA regulation 3. 3, she is entitled to a full refund of her fare of 6,800 rupees, and under paragraph 3. 3.3 she is also owed cancellation compensation of 6,100 rupees. I'd like to request both the full refund to the original payment method and the compensation.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, Asha Rao. Let me check the details for your booking reference K7M2QX.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's fine, please take your time.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: To process this I've sent a one-time code to the passenger's phone. Can you read me that OTP?

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: Hi, this is Asha, the passenger. The code is 3 8 5 0 4 8. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Asha. I've verified the OTP and can proceed with your request. I'll process a full refund to the original payment method and the cancellation compensation as per DGCA regulations. Your reference number is H W G Q 4 9.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Hotel Whiskey Golf Quebec Four Nine. Is there anything else my passenger needs to do on her end?
